title: 夜の読書とカフェ
lead: 読書灯・本棚・コーヒーなど、夜の読書とカフェの場面を紺と黄色の2色で12点描きました。書籍の紹介やカフェのメニューに使えます。
subject_en: two-colour duotone illustration using only deep navy blue and warm yellow-cream, with the navy as the closed outline and large shapes, the yellow as lamp light and highlights, quiet night mood, no people. Each item is a separate small subject centred in its cell with space around, never touching another. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates, clouds) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
items: a desk lamp lighting an open book
a coffee cup on a saucer beside a stack of books
a window with a crescent moon and curtains
a tall bookshelf with a small ladder
an armchair with a folded blanket
a sleeping cat curled on an open book
a small cafe front with a hanging lamp and a sign board with no writing
an open notebook with a fountain pen
a big moon behind a stack of books
